{{nihongo|'''Amatsukasahiko Shrine'''|天津賀佐彦神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Amatsukasa-hiko Shrine''' (あまつかさひこじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}{{ill|Mima, Tokushima|Q857828|qid=Q857828}}{{ill|Mimachō|Q11609479|qid=Q11609479}}.

=== History ===
The year of foundation is unknown. The *{{ill|Awa-shi|Q65291985|qid=Q65291985}}* states: “Amatsukahi-ko Shrine: listed in the *Engishiki*, also considered a minor shrine; located in Arakawa village of Shigekiyo; also called Nishioka-no-miya.”<ref>{{Cite web|Japanese-language book|url=https://www.buccyake-kojiki.com/archives/1070231126.html|title=Amatsukasa-hiko Shrine|publisher=Shrines and the Kojiki|accessdate=2021-05-21}}</ref>

It is one of the candidate shrines (ronsha) for Amatsukasa-biko Shrine, which is an {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Shina-nagato-be-no-Mikoto}}

=== Access ===
* About 10 minutes by car from “{{ill|Oshima Station|Q7106623|qid=Q7106623}}” on the {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}}{{ill|Tokushima Line|Q899310|qid=Q899310}}.
